claim: § When to Use This Pattern: 'does doubling feel like the same gesture as halving? If not, the mapping is wrong.'

pieces.what: Two sliders on one range, linear and log; the reader tries to double and halve from 1 on each and feels the distances.

Run the symmetry test live and show the numbers. The text's example values (0.79, 1.26 = 10^±0.1) fit 10 % either side of centre only on a one-decade slider; on the page's own 0.1–10 slider 10 % gives 0.63 and 1.58, and the step 'move 20 % right from center' reads ambiguously. The piece would catch both.
A filter cutoff swept linearly and logarithmically, heard.

note: The second piece tests the section's numbers; checked by hand here, not run. Carry home as an edit that changes no claim, shown to Loudon first.
